creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The `settings` config asset installs only to Claude Code today (`native.claude` fields into settings.json, each value owned separately via `configasset.FieldEdits`). Codex and OpenCode are declared unsupported and warn when an asset has a block for them.

Codex: fields under `native.codex` would go into `~/.codex/config.toml`, behind the existing `ConfigWriteConsent` prompt (tai re-renders that file, losing comments and key order). OpenCode: its own config file. Each needs the adapter's `ConfigFilePath` and `SupportedConfigAssetTypes` updated, and a check that the config-file engine's TOML path handles nested tables and arrays the way `FieldEdits` emits them.

Split out of card support-settings.
title: Settings assets for Codex and OpenCode
